newsitem.title: FINLAND: Fiskars proposes FIM 3.00 bonus dividend.
newsitem.headline: Fiskars proposes FIM 3.00 bonus dividend.

text.p: Finnish consumer goods group Fiskars Oy Ab said in a statement on Friday its board proposed bonus dividends of 3.00 markka per share for 1996 on top of unchanged 7.50 markka A-share and 6.70 markka K-share dividends.
"The board proposes a bonus of 3.00 markka per share for both shares of series A and series K. The total dividend distribution would thus be 76.2 million markka," Fiskars said.
Dividend payouts for 1995 totalled 53.8 million markka.
It earlier reported a nine percent rise in 1996 profit after financial items to 215 million markka.
